cabecera.tooltipPrincipal: In this section you will find information about the admission and graduate profiles, the curriculum map, the study plan, and the program's institutional identity.

fila1.descripcion: Graduates will be able to analyze, design, develop, and implement software and hardware systems; manage IT projects; apply engineering methodologies and standards; and communicate results orally and in writing in professional and academic settings.
fila1.textoExtra: Computer engineers can work in public and private sector organizations in software development, databases, networks, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, teaching and research, as well as in technology entrepreneurship.

fila2.descripcion: Applicants are encouraged to have a solid foundation in mathematics (algebra, geometry, precalculus), logical and abstract reasoning skills, as well as an interest in technology and solving problems using computers.
fila2.textoExtra: It is desirable to have analytical skills, teamwork ability, discipline for self-directed study, scientific curiosity, and a willingness to continuously update one's knowledge in a constantly evolving field.

mision.descripcion: To educate computer engineering professionals with a strong scientific and humanistic foundation, capable of analyzing, designing, implementing, and managing technological solutions that contribute to societal development, in alignment with UNAM principles and values.

vision.descripcion: To be a leading academic program in computer engineering education, recognized for teaching quality, engagement with industry, and contributions to innovation, research, and the training of professionals committed to Mexico.

valores.descripcion: Honesty, responsibility, respect, equity, freedom of thought and critique, commitment to academic excellence, collaborative work, and service to the university community and society.

pasos.tituloSeccion: Get your degree in 3 simple steps
pasos.hintInteraccion: Hover over the numbers to learn more details

paso1.descripcion: These are the certificates you have obtained throughout your academic journey.

paso2.titulo: Choose and complete your degree certification modality
paso2.descripcion: Choose according to your interests and personal goals—you should enjoy the process!

paso3.titulo: Track your status and receive your degree
paso3.descripcion: Congratulations! you are now a graduate of the Computer Engineering program.

col1.parrafo1: Throughout your time as a student, you will obtain each of the following documents for your eventual degree certification.
col1.parrafo2: The first four documents are required to begin your degree certification process.

filaInicio.botonEnviar: I want to submit my documentation!

col1.parrafo1: Documents 5 through 7 are required to complete your degree certification process; however, they are not essential to choose and carry out your degree certification modality.
col1.parrafo2: If you have any questions, contact the ICO program office.

doc1.texto: To obtain it, review your academic record/progress on https://www.dgae-siae.unam.mx/www_gate.php and verify that the term 11 completion label appears. The corresponding document is then used as support to continue your degree certification process.

doc2.texto: This is the official document stating that your social service has been validated and recognized by UNAM. To obtain it, you must first register where you want to complete your social service in UNAM's social service registration system at https://siassypp.unam.mx/, or visit the program office for guidance on internal social service openings. Remember that you must have completed at least 70% of your total credits; do not forget to bring your updated academic transcript.

doc3.texto: This is the official document certifying that you have reading comprehension in English. You can obtain it from the FES Aragón language center. If the certificate is digital, you must print it on colored opaline paper.

doc4.texto: The complementary training hours certificate is an official document certifying that the graduate has completed the required hours in extracurricular activities established by the study plan. You can obtain this document at the program office.

doc5.texto: The studies certificate is requested during the initial stage of the degree certification process, in parallel with modality registration and the academic record review. To obtain it, you must bring your academic transcript with term 11 status and 4 oval passport-size photos (3.5 × 5 cm) to the school services office.

texto.parrafo1: This is the complete high school studies certificate issued by any UNAM campus. It officially certifies your upper secondary education when you completed high school there.
texto.parrafo2: To process it or request information, visit the CCH campus where you completed high school or consult UNAM's school certification guidelines.

doc7.texto: Go to https://ingreso.dgae.unam.mx:8020/consulta_avance_sl to obtain the academic record review dates. You will need your account number and password for the SIAE-DGAE system. It is important that the specific dates appear through the tenth item.

modalidadTitulacion.intro: Explore and choose from the different degree certification modalities available to you at FES Aragón. Keep in mind that you must complete the modality you select in order to finish your degree certification process. Choose according to your interests and personal goals.
modalidadTitulacion.hintModalidad: Click on the modality you are interested in to learn more details

conReplicaOral.descripcion: Includes thesis/tesina components and a research activity.

tesisTesina.descripcion: Written research work and its oral defense before a committee, according to the stages outlined in your study plan.

paso1.titulo: Tutor selected and approved by the academic committee
paso1.texto: You must have an academic tutor selected and approved by the programme's academic committee, who guides the preparation of the written work.

paso2.titulo: Formal project registration with programme office
paso2.texto: Procedure with the programme office to formally register the research project or written work, following the formats, requirements, and calendar indicated by the office.

paso3.titulo: Final draft approved by the tutor
paso3.texto: The tutor must sign a document certifying that the work is finished and meets the requirements; this formally approves the final draft.

paso4.texto: Presentation and defence of the graduate's work before a committee.

actividadInvestigacion.descripcion: Participation in a research project and presentation of results before a committee.

paso1.titulo: Certified participation in a project (min. 1 semester)
paso1.texto: Participation in an active research project for at least one semester. The project must be endorsed by a recognised academic institution; the principal investigator must issue an acceptance letter. You also need a certificate or document proving participation, filed with the programme office or the relevant authority.

paso2.titulo: Detailed report of activities and results
paso2.texto: Document detailing the activities carried out in the project and the results obtained, as evidence of the work during the research activity. It is prepared with guidance from the tutor or academic advisor.

paso3.texto: Presentation before a committee where the results of the research activity and the report are presented and defended.

sinReplicaOral.descripcion: Focuses on professional or teaching experience, complemented by social service and an academic article.

apoyoDocencia.descripcion: Teaching support at the faculty: preparation of materials and guidance with a faculty advisor.

paso1.texto: Academic work aimed at producing materials or products that support teaching and learning or research activities. Creating such material requires approval by the academic committee, faculty supervision, and evaluation by pedagogical specialists.

paso2.texto: You must have formal selection of a faculty advisor: an academic who guides, supervises, and validates the graduation work according to the modality and programme office guidelines.

trabajoProfesional.descripcion: Verifiable work experience and documentation of work performed in the professional field.

paso1.texto: Proof of two years of continuous work; multiple employment periods are allowed as long as gaps do not exceed 15 days between periods. The document must be on company letterhead, bear a handwritten signature, and specify the employment period and activities performed.

paso2.texto: A technical-academic report in which the graduate documents professional experience in a field related to their training, demonstrating applied knowledge, skills, and solving real problems. The document is prepared with a faculty advisor who validates the work.

servicioSocial.descripcion: Completion of social service and submission of the documentation required by this modality.

paso1.texto: 100% of total credits on the academic transcript with termination status 11.

paso2.texto: This official document certifies English reading comprehension. You can obtain it from the FES Aragón language centre. If the certificate is digital, print it in colour on opaline paper.

paso3.texto: The complementary training hours certificate is an official document certifying that the graduate has completed the required hours in extracurricular activities set by the study plan. You can obtain this document at the programme office.

paso4.texto: Academic report in which the graduate documents activities during social service, highlighting applied knowledge and the impact of the work. The report is developed with guidance from an academic advisor.

paso5.titulo: Termination letter and release of social service
paso5.texto: This document is not required to register the graduation modality; however, it is required to complete the procedure.

articuloAcademico.descripcion: Publication in an indexed journal and proof of authorship or co-authorship of the article.

paso1.texto: Participate in a research project endorsed by a faculty member. Evidence required: journal cover, indexing data and ISSN/ISBN identifiers, acceptance letter for the article in an indexed journal, and a copy of the article showing institutional affiliation.

paso2.texto: The graduate must appear as author or co-author of the publication. For co-authorship, a letter from the principal investigator confirming the graduate's participation is required.

sinTrabajoEscrito.descripcion: Base requirements are met and a general exam (CENEVAL/EGEL) and performance conditions are completed, with the possibility of graduate studies.

examenGeneralCeneval.descripcion: Requirements for the general graduation exam (EGEL/CENEVAL) and performance records.

paso1.texto: You must take the General Examination for the Completion of the Bachelor's Degree (EGEL) in Computer Engineering and keep the pass certificate issued by the testing organisation (CENEVAL/EGEL) that proves a passing result.

paso2.texto: You must have the official results certificate issued by CENEVAL (document certifying your performance on the exam).

altoNivelAcademico.descripcion: Academic excellence criteria: grade point average, transcript with no failed courses, and completion within the standard program duration.

paso1.texto: A final grade point average of 9.5 is required, verifiable with the academic transcript.

paso2.texto: All courses must have been taken in the regular term, with no failures or make-up exams.

paso3.texto: It is mandatory to have completed coursework within the standard curriculum time.

estudiosPosgrado.descripcion: Admission to and continuation in recognized and authorized graduate programs.

paso1.texto: The graduate programme must be endorsed by the institution (not every programme qualifies). You must meet the admission requirements of the graduate programme. You must submit an acceptance letter for the graduate programme you enter.

paso2.titulo: Proof of satisfactory completion of the first semester
paso2.texto: The graduate programme must be authorised or validated by the institution for this modality. Proof of satisfactory completion of the first semester in that programme is required.

cursosAmpliacion.titulo: Courses for expanding and deepening knowledge
cursosAmpliacion.descripcion: Additional courses to broaden and deepen competencies, with a required minimum grade point average.

paso1.texto: Enrol in additional courses equivalent to approximately 10% of the total credits in the study plan and complete them in an additional semester term. The courses must differ from those already taken.

paso2.texto: All extra courses must be passed with a minimum grade of 9.

diplomado.descripcion: Diploma program with required hours, minimum grade, and validation by the corresponding committee.

paso1.texto: The course must last at least 240 hours.

paso3.titulo: Must be approved by the committee
paso3.texto: The course or diploma must be endorsed by the programme committee; otherwise it is not valid for this modality.
